construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch within the isolated build directory

shared_schema.input: Object: schema_version='1.0', synthetic=true, records[1..100]. Each record: unique opaque REC- record_id, entity policy|claim|underwriting_submission, severity low|medium|high|critical, submission {format,content}.

sources.acord_xml: Plain ACORD root with PolicyholderRef, Feedback and optional PolicyholderName, VIN, PropertyAddress, LossAmount, LossDate elements; no namespaces, attributes, nested elements or DTDs.
sources.claim_text: Claim-only form: one XML-style field name: value per line; Feedback is a single line.

shared_schema.constraints: SYN- policyholder references; bounded text; optional nonnegative finite numeric loss amount and ISO loss date; fabricated 17-character VIN. Claims require claim_handling {decision:pending|approved|denied,reasons:[nonempty text]}. Underwriting requires unique underwriting_factors {name,value,disclosed:true} from vehicle_age, property_age, prior_claims, loss_amount, coverage_limit. Unknown fields rejected.
shared_schema.output: Object: status, schema_version, synthetic, results, method, safeguards. Results contain record_id, entity, severity, sentiment {score,label,matches}, priority {score,band,reasons,rank}, claim_handling human-review explanation or null, underwriting_factors.
shared_schema.validation: All supported formats converge in parse_source and normalize before any scoring. CLI errors are one JSON object with status=error and exit 2; success exit 0.

cross_stage_handoffs: Single integrated stage: format adapters -> shared canonical validation -> lexicon sentiment -> severity-aware ranking -> minimized JSON output. No external stage or provider.

behavior.sentiment: Fixed transparent lexicon, immediate-token negation, clipped integer score -5..5; unmatched text neutral.
behavior.priority: Severity base 0/10/20/30 plus negative sentiment penalty 0..5. Severity always dominates. Descending score, ascending opaque record ID breaks ties.
behavior.claims: Supplied decisions must state reasons; always emit human review, never approve or deny using sentiment. Reason content is validated but not retained in output.
behavior.privacy: Only required triage fields retained in normalized records. Free text, source policyholder identifiers, names, addresses, VINs and loss details are omitted from output. No logs or persistence of inputs.
behavior.underwriting: Disclosure required and allowlist rejects hidden/protected factors. Factors are echoed transparently but never used in triage priority.
behavior.fixtures: All records are clearly labeled synthetic; names, VIN and property addresses are invented. Loss amounts and dates were generated with random.Random(3011), uniform(500,40000) rounded to cents and 2025-01-01 plus randrange(365) days, persisted for deterministic execution.

excluded: Full natural-language understanding, sarcasm and multilingual support

test_outcomes.cli: passed: example prints one JSON object with status ok, exit 0; usage, file, JSON and schema errors tested with status error and exit 2
